title: JEHOVAH SHAMMAH, THE GOD WHO IS THERE, GO AHEAD OF ME INTO EVERY ROOM I ENTER TODAY!
text: Today, the office you're about to enter, the hospital corridor you are dreading, the meeting room where a decision will be made about your future while you are not even present to defend yourself, the kitchen where a difficult conversation has been avoided for weeks. I need you to understand something about every single one of those rooms before you take even one more step toward them. Ezekiel chapter 48 verse 35 gives us the exact name I want to plant in your spirit this morning. After describing in extraordinary detail the entire restored city of God's dwelling, the final verse closes with this. It was round about 18,000 measures. And the name of the city from that day shall be The Lord is there. In the original language, this name is Jehovah Shammah. I want you to notice this is not a description of what God occasionally does. It is a name, an identity, something permanently attached to a specific location because of what is permanently true about it. The city is not named for its walls, its measurements, its architecture. It is named for one single reality. The Lord is there. I want you to sit with the specific weight of that naming. A name given to a place changes how that place is perceived forever afterward. You do not walk into a city named The Lord is there, wondering whether his presence might show up eventually if circumstances cooperate. The name has already settled the matter before you ever arrive. I decree over you this morning, every room you're about to enter today carries this exact same potential naming. Not because the room itself is naturally sacred, but because you, carrying the presence of God within you, make it so the moment you walk through its door, the specific room does not need to already be holy before you arrive. Your arrival carrying Jehovah Shammah within you is precisely what makes it so. I feel rising even in the middle of this teaching. There is someone reading or hearing this exact sentence who has been dreading a specific room on today's schedule, [music] a specific meeting, a specific conversation, a specific waiting room already assuming that whatever happens there will unfold entirely according to the other people present at entirely outside your own control or covering. I speak to that specific dread this morning. That room does not get to decide on its own terms whether God is present within it. You are bringing him with you and the name over that room changes the moment you cross his threshold. Let the fire climb higher because this morning's title does not merely ask for God's presence to accompany you into today's rooms. It asks for him to go ahead of you arriving before you do. Deuteronomy chapter 31 verse 8 gives us this exact promise. And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee. He will be with thee. He will not fail thee, neither forsake thee. Fear not, neither be dismayed. I want you to notice the specific sequence described here. Go before and then be with. This is not a God who merely tags along behind you reacting to whatever you walk into. This is a God who has already arrived, already assessed, already prepared the ground before your own feet ever cross the threshold. I decree over you this morning. Every room on your schedule today has already been visited by God before you ever enter it. Whatever atmosphere, whatever personality, whatever decision is already in motion within those walls has already encountered his presence first. You are never walking into unfamiliar territory. You are walking into territory he has already gone ahead to prepare. Psalm 139 verses 7 through 10. Take this promise even further. Whither shall I go from thy spirit, or whither shall I flee from thy presence? If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there. If I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there. If I take the wings of the morning and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea, even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me. I want you to notice this Psalm names the most extreme possible locations. Heaven itself, the depths of hell, the uttermost parts of the sea, and declares his presence genuinely inescapable across every single one of them. I speak to someone connected to this prayer this morning who has a specific room on today's schedule that feels genuinely hostile, genuinely uncomfortable, a room you would avoid entirely if you had any other choice. [music] I decree over you this morning, that room is not somehow exempt from this promise. If his presence reaches the uttermost parts of the sea and the very depths of hell itself, it certainly reaches whatever ordinary room is currently making you anxious today. Let a decree rise here before we press further. I declare that God has already gone ahead of me into every room on today's schedule arriving before I do. I declare that there is no room genuinely hostile enough, genuinely uncomfortable enough to exist outside the reach of his presence. I declare Jehovah Shammah over my entire day, every single location I will occupy from this moment until I lay my head down again tonight. I want to leave you with one final thought before we move into sustained prayer because I believe it anchors everything already taught. Exodus chapter 33 verse 14 gives us God's own direct promise to Moses, and he said, my presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest. I want to notice the specific connection made here, presence producing rest, not presence producing additional pressure to perform correctly in front of it. Too many of you have been walking into today's rooms carrying genuine anxiety about whether you will say the right thing, present the right image, handle the moment correctly on your own. [music] This verse reframes the entire posture. His presence going ahead of you was never meant to increase the pressure you feel. It was meant to produce genuine rest regardless of what the room itself requires of you. Let the declarations rise now with full weight before we move into extended prayer. I declare Jehovah Shammah over every room I enter today. I declare that God has already gone ahead of me into each one arriving before I do. I declare rest, not anxious performance as the genuine posture I carry into every single space today holds. We move now into sustained extended prayer and I want you to understand the posture we are praying from. We are not approaching as people uncertain whether God's presence genuinely extends into the specific ordinary rooms today requires us to occupy. We are approaching from the position this teaching has just established a name, already settled over every location, a presence already gone ahead and rest already promised regardless of what each room demands. From that established position we bring every specific need before the God whose name is literally permanently, the Lord is there. Let us begin with destiny because the room where your next genuine opportunity will finally open has already been visited by the God who goes ahead of you. Ecclesiastes chapter 3 verse 1 reminds us there is a time for every purpose under heaven. Father, in the name of Jesus, we bring before you every dream connected to this prayer that has been quietly gathering dust, set aside because life got demanding, because rejection made it too painful to keep reaching for. We ask that you would breathe on those dreams this morning the way you breathe on the valley of dry bones in Ezekiel chapter 37, bringing bone to bone, sinew and flesh covering what had looked permanently lifeless. I decree that every room assigned to hold your next breakthrough already carries your presence, waiting specifically for you to walk in and discover it. Let us turn now to the family because the specific room where a difficult family conversation has been avoided for weeks also already carries this exact promise. Joshua chapter 24 verse 15 gives us the household declaration. As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. Father, in the name of Jesus, we bring before you every family connected to this prayer where a painful pattern has repeated across multiple generations. We ask you to go to the root of these patterns this morning and do the kind of surgery no family conversation alone could accomplish, going ahead of every family member into whatever room genuinely needs this exact healing today. Let us turn to marriage. Genesis chapter 2 verse 24 describes the mystery of two becoming one flesh, a fusion so complete that separating it requires tearing, something never designed to be torn. Father, in the name of Jesus, we ask you to go specifically ahead of every married couple connected to this prayer into whatever room, whatever conversation, whatever shared decision today requires of them, restoring genuine intimacy wherever distance has quietly taken root. For those single and believing for marriage, I decree that the specific room where you will eventually meet the person God has prepared is already carrying his presence, waiting for both of you to finally arrive within it. Let the declarations rise now over all three. I declare that every room connected to my destiny, my family, and my marriage already carries the presence of the God who goes ahead of me into each one. [music] Let us turn now to finances because the specific room where a financial decision will be made today, whether a meeting with a lender, a conversation about a bill, or simply the quiet room where you review your own accounts already carries this exact presence. Malachi chapter 3 verse 10 issues a direct challenge. Bring the tithes into the storehouse, prove him, and watch whether he will not open the windows of heaven. Father, in the name of Jesus, we ask you to go specifically ahead of everyone connected to this prayer into whatever financial room today requires them to enter. Deuteronomy chapter 8 verse 18 reminds us it is the Lord who gives power to get wealth. I speak to every closed door connected to the finances represented here. Move in the name of Jesus this very day in whatever specific room that closed door is currently located within. Let us turn now to health because the hospital room, the clinic waiting area, the specific appointment on today's calendar that someone connected to this prayer is genuinely dreading already carries this exact promise as well. Exodus chapter 15 verse 26 gives us the covenant name. I am the Lord that healeth thee. Father, in the name of Jesus, we lift up every sick body connected to this prayer this morning and we ask you to go specifically ahead of them into whatever medical room today requires. Already present in that exact space before the appointment even begins. Isaiah chapter 53 verse 5 declares with his stripes we are healed. A transaction already completed before any diagnosis is ever delivered within those walls. I speak specifically to someone connected to this prayer about to walk into a room today to receive results they have genuinely dreaded, test results, a diagnosis, [music] news about a loved one's condition. I decree over that specific room this morning. Jehovah Shammah has already gone there ahead of you. Whatever is spoken in that room, you do not enter it alone and you do not enter it unprepared. Let the declarations rise now with full weight. I declare that every financial room and every medical room connected to this prayer today already carries the presence of God gone ahead specifically to meet you there. Now we must go somewhere many prayers avoid because pretending covenants, curses and altars are not genuinely operating has never once made anyone safer from them and some of today's rooms carry exactly this kind of residue invisible to the natural eye. Deuteronomy chapter 28 lays out both the blessings that follow covenant faithfulness and the curses that follow covenant violation. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come against every covenant made on behalf of the people connected to this prayer without their knowledge and we specifically ask you to go ahead of them into any room today where that exact residue remains active cleansing the atmosphere before they ever arrive. Numbers chapter 23 verse 23 declares there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. I sense there is a specific room on someone's schedule today, a specific office, a specific home, a specific gathering place where genuine spiritual opposition has been deliberately stationed to intercept exactly this kind of breakthrough. I speak to that specific room this morning. Whatever has been assigned there, your assignment is canceled because Jehovah Shammah has already arrived before the one you were targeting ever walks through that door. Let the fire rise now toward angelic assistance because the same God who goes ahead of you also commands angelic escort alongside you. Psalm 34 verse 7 tells us the angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and delivereth them. Father, in the name of Jesus, we ask for that encampment established over every room connected to this prayer today. Angels already positioned at the door before anyone connected to this prayer ever walks through it. 2 Kings chapter 6 verse 17 records Elisha's servant's eyes being opened to see the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire that had been present the entire time. I pray that same opening over everyone connected to this prayer this morning, perceiving what has always been present but previously [music] invisible in every room today requires them to enter. Let the declarations rise now with full authority. Every altar assigned to intercept the blessings of the people connected to this prayer today catch fire and be reduced to ash before they ever arrive. I declare angels already stationed in every room connected to this prayer encamped there ahead of every single person this prayer represents. Let us confront directly what many prayers avoid naming. Micah chapter 5 verse 12 speaks of God cutting off witchcraft out of the land, a direct acknowledgement that such operations exist and fall under divine jurisdiction to be dismantled. Father, in the name of Jesus, we stand this morning against every witchcraft gathering, every coven meeting, every secret assembly convened specifically to name and target the destinies of people connected to this prayer, especially any assignment deliberately stationed within a specific room is this exact day require someone connected to this prayer to enter. We command confusion into the camp of any such gathering, the same confusion that scattered the builders at Babel. I decree this morning with full authority, every arrow fired against the body, the marriage, the finances or the destiny of someone connected to this prayer return now to the sender in the name of Jesus. Colossians chapter 2 verse 15 reminds us Christ having spoiled principalities and powers made a show of them openly triumphing over them in the cross. We do not engage this morning out of fear. The outcome remains uncertain. [music] We engage out of confidence in a victory already completed 2,000 years ago. A victory that has already gone ahead of us into every single room today holds. Let the declarations rise once more with maximum intensity. Every witchcraft operation stationed specifically inside a room, someone connected to this prayer will enter today, lose your window of opportunity permanently because the window you depended on has already been sealed by the blood of the lamb and Jehovah Shammah has already claimed that room before your assignment ever had the chance to activate within it. Let us turn to something quieter now, the slow theft of time and virtue. Joel chapter 2 verse 25 gives us the promise, I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. Father in the name of Jesus, we ask for the restoration of stolen years over everyone connected to this prayer this morning. Remember the woman with the issue of blood in Mark chapter 5 whose touch drew virtue from Jesus in a room genuinely crowded, genuinely chaotic and still found exactly the present she needed within it. Isaiah chapter verse 31 promises those who wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength, mounting up with wings as eagles. I decree that renewal happening this morning so that you walk into every room today not merely present but genuinely restored at a level ordinary preparation alone could never produce. Let us turn now to divine preservation because everything prayed so far requires an ongoing covering to remain secure across every single room. This entire day will require you to occupy. Psalm 121 tells us the one who keeps Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for being that keeper this morning over every life connected to this prayer. We ask for preservation over physical bodies from accident, [music] from sudden illness in every single room today holds. We ask for a hedge as scripture describes concerning Job surrounding every person and possession connected to this prayer following them from room to room throughout this entire day. Let the declarations rise now with full weight. I declare every year the low cost has eaten in the lives connected to this prayer being repaid today. I declare that every life connected to this prayer is preserved today. Body, mind, spirit, marriage, family, finances, reputation under a covering that does not slumber and does not sleep. Moving with you from room to room, from meeting to meeting, from conversation to conversation until this entire day fully concludes. Let us widen this prayer now to cover specific people and specific rooms. The spirit is highlighting this morning. I speak to students connected to this prayer walking into an examination room today, a classroom, a lecture hall genuinely demanding more than they feel prepared to offer. Daniel chapter 1 verse 17 tells us God gave Daniel and his companions knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom. Father, in the name of Jesus, go ahead of every student connected to this prayer into that exact room today. I turn to ministers and spiritual servants connected to this prayer, walking into a sanctuary, a counseling room, a hospital bedside visit, pouring out whatever they have left for someone else's benefit. Second Corinthians chapter 12 verse 9 records the Lord's answer to Paul's plea for relief. My grace is sufficient for thee. I turn to those fighting addiction walking into a room today where the exact same temptation that has defeated them before is waiting. Romans chapter 8 verse 2 declares the law of the spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made us free from the law of sin and death. Father, in the name of Jesus, go specifically ahead of them into that exact room arriving there before the temptation itself does. I turn to those grieving walking into a room today that still holds the specific absence of someone genuinely missed. Psalm 68 verse 5 describes God as a father of the fatherless and a judge of the widows. I turn to business owners connected to this prayer walking into a boardroom, a client meeting, a negotiation genuinely uncertain in its outcome. Psalm 1 verse 3 describes the blessed person as a tree planted by rivers of water. I turn to parents connected to this prayer walking into a room today to have a difficult conversation with a child who has been distant lately. Luke chapter 15 gives us the picture of the prodigal son and the father did not chase him down the road but saw him while he was yet a great way off. Let the declarations rise now over every category and every room addressed here. I declare that God has already gone ahead of every student, every minister, every person fighting addiction, every grieving heart, every business owner, every parent connected to this prayer into the exact room each of them will occupy today. I feel the atmosphere shifting now into something more spontaneous. The kind of moment where the spirit stops following any prepared structure and simply begins speaking directly to specific people scattered across wherever this prayer has found its way this morning. Let your spirit remain open because not every word will apply directly to you, but somewhere in what follows something is going to land with such precision, you will know immediately it was written specifically for you. There is a specific room on your calendar today that you have been dreading for days, rehearsing every possible way it could go wrong and the Lord says I have already been in that room. Walk in expecting what I have already prepared, not what your anxiety has already predicted. There is a meeting today where a decision about your future is being made without you physically present and heaven says I am present in that room even though you are not and the outcome is being shaped by my presence, not merely by the people seated at that table. There is someone about to walk into a hospital room today to see someone they love and certain what condition they will find them in and the Lord says I am already in that room and I have been there the entire time you were not. There is a phone call someone has been dreading making essentially a room with only a voice inside it and the Lord says I go ahead of that call too. Dial the number. Somebody is about to walk into a courtroom, a mediation room, a room where a legal matter will finally be addressed and the Lord says the verdict is not determined solely by what is argued in that room. I have already gone ahead of you into it. [music] There is someone walking into a job interview today nervous about every possible question and the Lord says the room is already mine. You are simply walking into territory I have already claimed. Somebody is sitting in their car right now, outside a specific building, unable to make themselves walk inside and the Lord says I am already inside. Come in. Before we move toward the closing of this administration, I want to leave you with a charge that carries you beyond today alone. Revelation chapter 12 verse 11 tells us they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. I charge you tonight after this exact day concludes to become a testifier of whatever happened in whatever room you walked into carrying this exact expectation. Do not keep it to yourself. Tell someone who is still dreading their own version of today's room. [music] I charge you also to guard carefully what has been established through this morning prayer. Matthew chapter 12 verses 43 through 45 gives us a sobering warning about an unclean spirit that goes out of a man finding its former house empty, swept, and garnished only to bring seven other spirits more wicked than itself to occupy what had been left vacant. Father, in the name of Jesus, help everyone connected to this prayer occupy with genuine devotion. Every room this morning's declaration has cleared, rather than leaving it vacant the moment today concludes, I charge you finally to remain tender even as you walk into today rooms with genuine authority because this exact confidence was never meant to produce arrogance toward the people you will meet within them. First Corinthians chapter 13 reminds us that even the most impressive spiritual gifts amount to nothing without love genuinely undergirding them. Let the declaration rise now over all three of these charges. I declare that I will not keep silent about what God accomplishes in today's rooms. I declare that what has been established this morning remains permanently occupied by genuine devotion. I declare that genuine authority produces genuine compassion toward everyone I encounter today, not distance from them. Let a final wave of comprehensive declarations rise now, gathering together everything this ministration has addressed. I declare over every household represented here this morning, peace be unto this house and over every room within it. I declare over every marriage represented here, what God has genuinely joined together, no scheme of hell shall be permitted to separate in whatever room that marriage is currently tested the most. I declare over every finance represented here, the hand of the Lord opens what has been shut [music] in whatever specific room that closed door is genuinely located. I declare over everybody represented here, sickness loses its legal ground completely in every medical room connected to this prayer today. I declare over every destiny represented here, what was delayed accelerates now, discovered in whatever room has been waiting to finally reveal it. I declare over every family represented here, generational patterns find their genuine termination point, confronted directly in whatever room that confrontation genuinely requires. I declare over every wandering child represented here, your wandering has an expiration date and the room where you finally come home is already being prepared. I declare over every minister, every addiction, every betrayal, every stalled relocation, every overlooked worker, every struggling business, every fractured relationship, every anxious mind represented here this morning, God has already gone ahead of you into every single room today will require you to enter, not eventually, not once. You have proven sufficient worthiness. Right now, in this exact hour, before you ever take a single step toward any of them, Jehovah Shammah has already claimed the ground you're about to walk into. Let me add one final word before we move toward the true benediction, because I believe it seals everything already declared this morning. Matthew chapter 28 verse 20 gives us Christ's own closing promise to his disciples, and lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. I want you to notice this is not a promise with any specific expiration date attached to it, no specific room exempted, no specific hour of today carved out as somehow beyond its reach. I decree over you this morning, always [music] means every single room today holds without exception. It means the room you are genuinely excited to enter and the room you have been quietly dreading for days. It means the room where good news is waiting and the room where difficult news must still be delivered. Always does not negotiate its own boundaries based on how comfortable or uncomfortable a specific room happens to be. Let the declarations rise now over this final promise. I declare that Christ's own words, always even unto the end of the world, cover every single room today requires of me without a single exception. I declare that this presence does not wait for permission, does not wait for the room to feel ready, does not wait for circumstances to improve before it arrives. It is already there, because his name is Jehovah Shammah, and that name does not change from room to room. Let us pray finally over something easy to overlook, the spaces [music] between the rooms themselves, the hallways, the elevators, the sidewalks, the vehicles carrying you from one specific location to the next throughout today. Psalm 121 verse 8 promises that the Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forever more. Father in the name of Jesus, we speak that specific preservation over every transition today requires not merely the rooms themselves but the genuine movement between them. Every vehicle, every hallway, every brief walk from one door to the next. I declare that every transition today holds is covered exactly as thoroughly as every room it connects. I declare that no accident, no delay, no genuine danger assigned to intercept you between one room and the next will locate his target. I declare that Jehovah Shammah governs not merely the destinations today requires of you but the entire journey between them from this exact moment until you finally lay your head down again tonight in the mighty name of Jesus. Let one more wave of these specific words move through this space before we close. There is someone whose landlord is about to make an unexpected concession on a matter that seemed completely fixed, decided in a room you will not even personally need to enter. There is a man who lost his job months ago and the Lord says the right room holding the right position is closer than the accumulated rejections have led you to believe. Somebody's teenager is about to open up about something they have been hiding in a conversation that will happen in an ordinary room you have walked past a hundred times without ever expecting it to hold something this significant. There is someone whose small business has finally started gaining genuine traction and the next client meeting in a room that feels entirely ordinary is about to become the specific room where everything genuinely shifts. There is a person who has been secretly ashamed of a physical scar or visible difference, afraid of how a specific room full of people will perceive them today and the Lord says I am already in that room. And what you fear being seen as is not what I've already determined. That room will actually reveal about you. There is someone who has avoided a specific room for months now, a certain office, a certain building, a certain person's presence, and the Lord says the avoidance has caused you more than the actual room ever would have. Walk in today. I am already there. Before we move into the true and final closing of this ministration, I want to thank you personally for remaining present throughout its entire length, for allowing your own heart to be stretched, challenged, comforted, and strengthened across everything we have worked through together this morning. Whatever specific room this teaching most directly addressed for you today, carry it forward with genuine, settled confidence. Galatians chapter 6 verse 9 encourages us not to grow weary in well doing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not. Let a final decree rise here before we move into the true benediction. I declare that this morning's contending was not performed in vain. [music] I declare that everyone who showed up to this prayer with genuine hunger, however tired, however anxious about whatever specific room today holds, receives exactly what their specific hunger was reaching for. I declare that the effort it took to remain present through this entire ministration is itself being counted as an offering, a fragrant sacrifice recorded in the courts of heaven. Let us come now to the closing benediction, but before we arrive there fully, I want to speak one more time directly to the specific theme this entire ministration was built around from its very beginning, the name permanently attached to a specific place because of what is permanently true about it. The Lord is there. Numbers chapter 6 verses 24 through 26 gives us the ancient priestly benediction spoken over God's people for thousands of years. And I want to speak it over you now as we approach the closing of this entire ministration. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for everything accomplished through this specific season of prayer this morning. We thank you for the teaching that has renewed understanding, for the declarations that have activated genuine authority, for the prayers that have addressed real specific need across every room this ministration has touched upon. We ask that everything spoken this morning would continue walking across every single room today still holds long after this specific moment of prayer concludes. I want to commission you now specifically for every room the remainder of today still requires you to enter. Go into each one, whatever it holds, not with the anxious uncertainty of someone unsure whether God's presence genuinely extends that far, but with the settled confidence of someone who has personally understood that his name is literally, permanently, the Lord is there. Let the final declaration of this benediction rise now with full and complete authority. I declare that everything spoken this morning is sealed by the blood of Jesus Christ, established in the courts of heaven and released into active operation across every room connected to this specific prayer. [music] I declare blessing, I declare keeping, I declare shining favor, I declare grace, I declare lifted countenance, and I declare peace over every single life this ministration has touched in the mighty, unshakable name of Jesus. As we arrive now at the genuine conclusion of this ministration, I want to bring us back full circle to exactly where we began. We began this morning with a single name permanently attached to a single city, not because of its architecture or its measurements, but because of one settled permanent reality. The Lord is there. We began with the discovery that this exact name was never confined to one ancient city alone. It travels with you into every single room today requires you to occupy. Everything else prayed this morning, the destiny restoration, the family deliverance, the marriage breakthrough, the financial gates, the healing, the covenant breaking, the angelic intervention, the witchcraft destruction, the time and virtue restored, the divine preservation, every specific word of knowledge and every specific category of situational prayer we walk through together. All of it flows directly out of that single foundational reality established at the very beginning. A person who genuinely believes God has already gone ahead of them into today's specific rooms, walks through each one fundamentally differently than someone still treating every unfamiliar space as genuinely unaccompanied territory. I want to ask you directly, one final time before we close, will you actually walk into today's rooms believing this exact name travels with you? Or will the moment this prayer ends find you quietly reverting to the anxious uncertainty that has perhaps characterized how you have approached unfamiliar rooms for years before this one? The real test of everything declared here will not be measured by how you feel in this exact moment. It will be measured by whether you actually walk through today's doors expecting him already there. Father, in the name of Jesus, we ask for that specific expectation over everyone connected to this prayer, trusting that the same name that settled over an entire ancient city remains just as available, just as permanent over every room you enter today. Let the final declaration of this entire ministration rise now, complete and sealed. I declare that Jehovah Shammah has already gone ahead of me into every room I will enter today. I declare that the Lord is there before I arrive, while I remain, and after I leave. Go now in the name of Jesus, carrying everything this ministration has deposited within you into every single space today holds. The name has already been spoken over every room on your schedule. The presence has already arrived. The God who never slumbers has already secured everything that genuinely matters long before this morning began, and he will continue securing it in every room you walk through until this entire day fully concludes. Amen.
